procedure.method: I read only the explicitly allowed pinned inputs and checked their SHA-256/byte bindings. The packet declares no source assets and no protected layouts. I read the five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their embedded source/call-input/pre-call/final paths. I actually loaded and visually examined all fifteen supplied poster files using tools.view_image with detail='original', emitting each returned image through functions.exec image(..., 'original'). Five functions.exec calls showed M1 through M5 in packet order; within each call the awaited view order was native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen images had been displayed and examined before I made the first transcription comparison, assigned any image score or assigned set diversity. The recorded first raw transcription is my native-view reading, retained with visible soft wraps and optical spaces. No ambiguity required a revisit. Native dimensions were checked from PNG IHDR bytes, and native RGB opacity was checked from the PNG data. No OCR, crop, derived poster, regeneration, peer review, fork or subagent was used. The session ID is not claimed; it is null for runner binding.

evidence.observation: Monochrome overhead human actions share the full-bleed surface with an orange middle-left title, upper-right logistics and lower-left participation. Unlike M2 it integrates text into a photographed working surface; unlike M4 it shows hands rather than an object catalogue.

evidence.location: top headline, diagonal blue/cream field and paired handoffs
evidence.observation: Flat illustrated handoffs cross a diagonal blue/cream split beneath a dominant top event name. Logistics sit mid-left and participation splits across the bottom, producing a bold graphic system distinct from M1 photography, M3 material edge, M4 object collage and M5 panels.

evidence.location: curved left textile seam and open right text field
evidence.observation: A macro fabric repair forms the compositional edge, with a single-line brush/serif-like title above widely spaced right-hand copy. It uses neither M1/M2 opposing handoffs nor M4 product grouping nor M5 sequential panels. M1 and M3 share tactile photography but have different crops and type/image organization.

evidence.location: four-object collage and bottom title strip
evidence.observation: Isolated photographed goods form a dense upper and middle mosaic, logistics start top-left, a highlighted bring instruction sits centrally, and the title anchors the bottom. This catalogue arrangement changes the reading structure as well as the medium relative to M1/M2; it is distinct from M3 and M5.

evidence.location: alternating three-panel story and text sidebars
evidence.observation: Three outlined narrative panels alternate with text columns, using warm drawn people, brush lettering and gold rules. Its explicit scene progression and distributed information differ from all four other systems, including the more emblematic illustration of M2.

residuals: M1, M2 and M4 share a heavy sans supporting voice and repeat books/clothing as content cues. Nevertheless their viewpoint, layout, hierarchy, color relations and type/image roles change substantially; these are five complete systems, not material or palette variants.
M4 retains hierarchy 3. No average or strong set-diversity score cancels that low dimension.
These are one critic’s bounded observations of this pinned five-member packet; no three-critic combined gate or unseen-case claim is made.
